configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Builds bgfx and the header-only dependencies from external/. Install and export are disabled in this configuration because the dependencies are vendored rather than found as packages.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised, with every optional log category compiled out. Only WARN and ERROR survive.

configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.displayName: Clang (the golden recording on a second compiler)
configurePresets.description: The dev build with Clang, tests only: what checks the physics replays bit for bit across compilers. ctest --preset clang -R projv_unit_tests, or build-clang/bin/projv_unit_tests -tc="golden*".

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: The dev build on Windows: Ninja with the MSVC compiler, run from a Developer Command Prompt (or after vcvars64.bat). Vendored dependencies except GLFW, which find_package takes from CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH (vcpkg install glfw3:x64-windows). Library and unit tests only until the examples build there. Plan: docs/plans/windows.md.

configurePresets.name: vcpkg
configurePresets.description: Resolves every dependency through find_package from a vcpkg toolchain, which is the configuration that can actually be installed and exported. Requires VCPKG_ROOT to be set.
